multi_tag_noise.lesson: Multi-tag interleaved A/Bs (7 variants in 61378825) inflated apparent HYB22 win to −3.7%; clean 2-way confirm collapsed to −0.037%.
rules: Prefer 2–3 tags only (CAND + KEEP_BASE [+ one prior tip]).
Require confirm on durable binaries with ROUNDS≥5 (prefer 8) before promoting.
Treat |geo| ≲ 1% or geo within mean CV / odd-even identity as MARGINAL.
Use --agg median; still report mean CV and leave-one-out range.
